description: Adds the Azure Storage Blob SDK so Tiger can store media in Azure Blob Storage — with no Composer needed on the server. Install it, activate it, then choose Azure Blob Storage in Settings → Media → Storage. Mutually exclusive with the AWS and Google Cloud SDK providers (one cloud SDK at a time).

review.notes: First-party provider module. Vendors microsoft/azure-storage-blob (MIT) as a release-asset bundle; ships no controllers/routes — Bootstrap registers the bundled SDK autoloader, active-only. type:sdk. Mutually exclusive with the AWS / Google Cloud SDK providers via module.json conflict.
